holdout: 2024 time-split holdout (train <= 2023, test Jan-Nov 2024, n=194), SolRPDS-labelled Solana pools, pre-event 30-minute launch-window state
calibration: CLEARANCE, not safety: this score answers one question — will this pool avoid a hard rug (near-total, >=99% liquidity removal)? A cleared pool avoided a hard rug at 0.984 precision, covering 0.538 of honest pools, measured on the 2024 time-split holdout (train <= 2023, test Jan-Nov 2024, n=194), SolRPDS-labelled Solana pools, pre-event 30-minute launch-window state. It does NOT answer whether the pool is safe: the honest-versus-soft/slow-rug boundary is absent from launch-window state (0.574 precision against a 0.500 base rate), so a cleared pool can still dev-dump or bleed out over months. Do not invert this into a rug alarm: used that way the same model measures 0.464 precision — wrong more often than right. Roughly 98.7% of pump.fun launches are scam-adjacent, so this is a filter for a small honest minority, judged on minority-class precision, never accuracy.
